_doc: THE single source of truth for what each Alex MODE requires — roster, persistent-team requirement, lifecycle bindings, provider tier, dispatch profile, and teardown policy (E-LIFECYCLE-001 / S-LC-01). Readers RESOLVE FROM HERE so a mode's roster is edited in ONE place: scripts/hooks/lib/mode-lifecycle.js (the shared reader), scripts/hooks/session-start.js (the persistent-team-init directive), and scripts/hooks/team-guard.js (the bootstrap-face allow-list) all derive their required-team-by-mode from this file. De-duplicates the formerly-hardcoded TEAM_MODES map (session-start) + FACE_TYPES literal (team-guard). The fail-closed drift validator scripts/checks/mode-lifecycle-registry.js earns it: the readers' fail-open FALLBACK constants must MATCH this registry or it exits non-zero. Mode resolution itself (mode.json → mode string) lives in lib/mode.js#getMode; this registry maps the resolved mode → its lifecycle contract. S-LC-01 does NOT build any gate from this (that is S-LC-03/04); it only makes this the source the existing readers READ.
description: Mode-Lifecycle Registry — mode → required-team/roster + bindings + provider-tier + dispatch-profile + teardown.

_field_meaning.roster: ordered role ids that make up the mode's working set (incl. the lead face). The persistent-team faces are roster minus 'alpha' (alpha is the harness session, not a spawned teammate). References .claude/agents/_org/role-registry.json by id.
_field_meaning.requires_team: true if the mode operates through a persistent team that must be stood up (sprint, adhoc); false if the lead runs standalone (solo, oneshot).
_field_meaning.bindings: which lifecycle artifacts the mode requires be present/active: sprint | epic | tracker | planning. Empty = no binding requirement.
_field_meaning.provider_tier: placeholder model-tier label for the mode's dispatch budget (T1 default). Concretized in S-LC-03/04; not consumed as a gate this sprint.
_field_meaning.dispatch_profile_ref: forward-ref into .claude/agents/_org/dispatch-contract.json for the mode's dispatch profile. The concrete per-mode profile anchor is wired in S-LC-03/04; carried here as the seam.
_field_meaning.teardown: policy for when the mode's team/state is torn down: none | session-end | run-end | phase-boundary.

teardown._note: Alpha works directly — no team to tear down.
α + β + γ persistent team; γ dispatches the build chain.
δ runs standalone and dispatches the full build chain directly.
α lead + ε conductor/quality-gate + β judgment; ε runs the full lifecycle, β consulted at the 4 phase boundaries.
